headline: El peso se depreció 2.26%, su mayor caída en un día desde abril de 2025,Sheinbaum sostiene diálogo con Trump en el marco de APEC
summary: The Mexican peso depreciated 2.26 percent, its largest one-day decline since April 2025. President Sheinbaum held a dialogue with Donald Trump on the sidelines of APEC.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency and is sensitive to US trade policy, since the US is Mexico's largest trading partner.
why_moved: The peso recorded its largest one-day fall since April 2025 in the same session as Sheinbaum's dialogue with Trump at APEC, a period of trade-relations focus.
